channel.title: Brazil Elections 2026
channel.description: Real-time monitoring of the 2026 Brazilian presidential elections.

item.title: Lula determina apoio federal a autoridades de Pernambuco devido às chuvas fortes em Recife
item.description: President Lula announced immediate federal support for Pernambuco authorities due to heavy rains in the Recife metropolitan area and Zona da Mata Norte, activating National Civil Defense, declaring a state of emergency, and mobilizing the National Health Force. Governor Raquel Lyra confirmed close monitoring, while Apac maintained a red alert. At least 80 people were displaced in Recife and 55 rescued in Cajueiro and Peixinhos, with flooding, landslides, and suspension of the Jaboatão metro line.

item.title: 'Vamos trabalhar em uma jornada 7x0 para reeleger Lula', diz Haddad
item.description: Fernando Haddad, former finance minister and PT's pre-candidate for São Paulo governor, said he will work in a '7x0' schedule to defend and re-elect President Lula in the 2026 elections, emphasizing the need for intense and continuous effort.

item.title: Derrotas no Congresso são derrotas no combate à corrupção, diz Haddad
item.description: Fernando Haddad, PT's pre-candidate for São Paulo governor, stated that the federal government's defeats in Congress represent setbacks in the fight against corruption. He specifically cited the Senate's rejection of Jorge Messias' nomination to the STF and Congress overturning Lula's vetoes on the Dosimetria bill, which he claims benefits former President Jair Bolsonaro.

item.title: Liberdade para a opinião antissemita
item.description: The text defends freedom of expression, even for antisemitic opinions, quoting Rosa Luxemburgo and criticizing the Brazilian left for supporting the judicial condemnation of José Maria de Almeida, PSTU leader, for calling for the elimination of Israel. The author states they agree with the German communist revolutionary's view.

item.title: Lula exalta IR, Gás do Povo e menor inflação acumulada no 1º de Maio
item.description: President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva highlighted economic achievements in a national broadcast on the eve of Labor Day, including income tax exemption for those earning up to R$5,000, the 'Gás do Povo' program, the lowest cumulative inflation in four years, low unemployment, and record average income. He announced expanded paternity leave, the end of the 6×1 work schedule (benefiting women especially), R$2 billion in credit for autonomous truckers with lower interest and 12-month grace period, and the removal of fuel taxes in response to Middle East war impacts. The speech was recorded before Jorge Messias’ STF nomination rejection and did not mention the Senate setback or congressional veto overrides.

item.title: Após derrotas de Lula, esquerda retoma ofensiva contra ‘Congresso inimigo do povo’
item.description: Left-wing protesters gathered in São Paulo's Roosevelt Square to oppose the 6×1 work schedule, condemning the National Congress as 'the people's enemy' following legislative defeats for Lula's government, including the Senate's rejection of Jorge Messias for the Supreme Court and the overturning of presidential vetoes on the Dosimetry Bill. Speakers such as Marina Silva, Sônia Guajajara, and Érika Hilton accused Congress of betrayal and called for a broad left front to reelect Lula and elect Fernando Haddad in 2026.

item.title: Filme sobre passagem de Michel Temer pelo Presidência da República será lançado em junho
item.description: The film '963 Days — The Story of a President Who Put Brazil Back on Track', directed by Bruno Barreto and produced by Elsinho Mouco, portrays the political trajectory of former president Michel Temer during his 963 days in office. It will premiere in theaters on June 14 in São Paulo, with a runtime of 1 hour and 40 minutes.

item.title: Decisões do Congresso sobre Messias e PL da Dosimetria foram 'derrota no combate à corrupção', diz Haddad
item.description: Former minister Fernando Haddad stated that the Lula government's recent congressional defeats regarding Jorge Messias' STF nomination and the veto override on the Dosimetria bill constitute a defeat in the fight against corruption, citing press analyses suggesting an impunity deal. Speaking at a May 1st event at Força Sindical alongside Marina Silva and Simone Tebet, he lamented the lack of accountability in recent scandals.

item.title: Após ter veto derrubado pelo Congresso, Lula não deve promulgar PL da Dosimetria; tarefa caberá a Alcolumbre
item.description: President Lula will not promulgate the bill reducing sentences for those convicted in the January 8 attacks, after Congress overrode his veto. The move is symbolic, aiming to avoid having his name associated with the legislation, with promulgation duty falling to Senate President Davi Alcolumbre. The government plans to use this in the 2026 election campaign, claiming Congress benefited coup plotters, while believing the STF will not intervene.

item.title: PT aproveita 1.º de Maio para lançar campanha e tentar aproximação com motoristas de aplicativo
item.description: The PT launched a social media campaign on May 1st to reach out to app-based drivers, double/triple-shift workers, and small entrepreneurs, advocating for the end of the 6X1 work schedule and a minimum R$10 payment per ride. The initiative aims to overcome historical resistance from these workers to Lula’s government proposals, which have failed to pass sector-specific legislation since 2023.

item.title: Crusoé: Futuro indefinido
item.description: The Brazilian Democratic Movement (MDB) celebrated its 60th anniversary on March 24, amid declining national influence and uncertainty about its stance in the 2026 presidential election. Despite having elected three former presidents — José Sarney, Itamar Franco, and Michel Temer — the party has yet to define its position or endorse candidates for 2026. This ambiguity reflects a broader strategic challenge in a fragmented political landscape.

item.title: Partidos com ministérios ajudaram a derrubar veto de Lula à dosimetria
item.description: Seven parties that currently hold or previously held ministries in Lula’s government voted to overturn his veto on the Dosimetria Bill, which reduces penalties for those involved in the January 8 attacks and may benefit Jair Bolsonaro. The PSB, Vice President Geraldo Alckmin’s party, had one deputy and three senators support the override despite its alliance with the PT. The PDT, which leads the Ministry of Social Security, recorded two favorable votes in the Senate and two in the Chamber, maintaining support for Lula’s re-election despite internal tensions.

item.title: Le Senado c’est moi: como Alcolumbre redesenha relação de Poderes ao derrotar Messias
item.description: Senate President Davi Alcolumbre imposed the rejection of Jorge Messias' nomination to the Supreme Federal Court, aligning with the opposition and delivering a historic defeat to President Lula in a secret vote. The move affirmed his institutional autonomy, signaling that no executive appointment proceeds without his approval and setting a new precedent in inter-branch relations. The action was seen as a strategic positioning ahead of his 2027 reelection bid and a rebuke to Lula for not selecting Rodrigo Pacheco for the vacancy.

item.title: Saiba como votou cada congressista na derrubada do veto à dosimetria
item.description: Congress overrode the presidential veto on the dosimetry bill, reducing penalties for coup-related crimes and benefiting former president Jair Bolsonaro and 849 individuals convicted in the January 8, 2023 attacks. In the Chamber, 318 voted against and 144 in favor of maintaining the veto; in the Senate, 49 to 24. The measure now takes effect, to be implemented by Minister Alexandre de Moraes.

item.title: ‘Melhor presente de aniversário que poderia receber’, diz Flávio sobre veto
item.description: Senator Flávio Bolsonaro celebrated the congressional override of President Lula's veto on the dosimetry bill, which reduces sentences for those convicted in the January 8 acts, calling it the 'best birthday present' as he turned 45. He said the move marks a new beginning for affected families and honors those unjustly punished, including his father, Jair Bolsonaro. The vote, backed by the Centrão and opposition, followed a procedural move by Congress President Davi Alcolumbre to unbundle the veto.

item.title: Marina: derrota com Messias não foi para o presidente Lula, quem perdeu foi o Brasil
item.description: Marina Silva stated that the rejection of Jorge Messias' nomination to the Supreme Federal Court was not only a defeat for President Lula, but a loss for Brazil as a whole. She emphasized that the decision represents an institutional setback and a threat to judicial independence.

item.title: Crusoé: Eduardo Bolsonaro conecta Trump à rejeição a Messias
item.description: Eduardo Bolsonaro linked the Senate's rejection of Jorge Messias for the STF to actions taken by the Donald Trump administration, suggesting a connection between the two. He shared a Washington Times article on his X account to support this argument. The content was first published on O Antagonista under the title 'Crusoé: Eduardo Bolsonaro connects Trump to Messias rejection'.

item.title: ‘Quem perdeu não foi o presidente Lula’, diz Marina sobre derrota de Messias
item.description: Marina Silva stated that the rejection of Jorge Messias for the Supreme Federal Court was a defeat for Brazil, not just for President Lula, and defended democracy as a tool for inclusion and social justice. Speaking at a Workers' Day event, she highlighted Lula administration achievements such as leaving the Hunger Map, and supported Haddad’s tax policies targeting the wealthy. She also cited labor struggles like ending the 6x1 work schedule and gender pay equity, and positioned herself and Simone Tebet as potential Senate candidates from São Paulo.

item.title: No Dia do Trabalhador, Lula cita queda no desemprego, ampliação da licença-paternidade e redução do IR
item.description: On Workers' Day, President Lula highlighted reduced unemployment and inflation, income tax exemption for those earning up to R$ 5,000, and a gradual expansion of paternity leave from 5 to 20 days by 2029. He announced a debt renegotiation program with interest capped at 1.99% per month and the use of up to 20% of FGTS balances to pay debts, alongside benefits such as electricity bill exemptions for low-income families and early payment of the 13th salary for retirees.

item.title: Oposição diz que Exército e STF se unem para “silenciar militares”
item.description: The opposition leader, Gilberto Silva (PL-PB), accused Army Commander General Tomás Ribeiro Paiva of adopting a political stance and aligning with the government and the STF to silence conservative military personnel, citing arbitrary transfers and delayed promotions. The accusation came two days after the STF unanimously ruled to make evangelical pastor Silas Malafaia a defendant for injuring the general’s honor, based on statements made in April 2025. Silva claims there is an alliance between the Army’s high command and the Judiciary to intimidate military personnel who uphold values like 'God, Homeland and Family'.

item.title: Elogio à equipe, críticas à oposição e frase sobre 'fracassos': os recados de Messias após ter sua indicação ao STF rejeitada pelo Senado
item.description: Following the Senate's rejection of his Supreme Court nomination, Attorney General Jorge Messias shared messages on social media expressing disappointment and gratitude. He thanked Supreme Court ministers André Mendonça and Gilmar Mendes for their support, praised his AGU team's dedication, and quoted Darcy Ribeiro on failures as victories, suggesting he may resign from his post.

item.title: Raphinha reforça pedido por Neymar na seleção brasileira para Copa do Mundo: 'É o cara do hexa'
item.description: Raphinha reiterated his support for Neymar's inclusion in Brazil's squad for the 2026 World Cup, calling him 'the man for the hexa' and stating he could help Brazil win the tournament. He also shared that he treasures a limited-edition boot Neymar wore when surpassing Pelé's goal record for the national team, calling it the most important item in his trophy collection. Raphinha, recovering from a right thigh muscle injury sustained in March, is expected to return to action for Barcelona this Saturday against Osasuna.

item.title: PL investe contra desembargador para pressionar STF a tomar decisão sobre eleição no Rio
item.description: The PL is pressuring the STF to decide on the format of the Rio de Janeiro gubernatorial election, fearing that the prolonged interim governorship of Justice Ricardo Couto undermines its electoral strategy. The party backs Douglas Ruas, president of the State Legislative Assembly, as interim governor to build momentum against Eduardo Paes (PSD) in the October election, but faces logistical and temporal challenges if the STF opts for direct elections or allows Couto to remain in office beyond the immediate term.

item.title: Crusoé: Lula tira folga no Dia do Trabalho e se enclausura no Alvorada
item.description: President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva has no official engagements scheduled for May 1st, International Workers' Day, according to the Planalto Palace agenda, indicating he will take the day off and remain at the Alvorada Palace. First Lady Janja also did not release an agenda for the date.

item.title: Marcos Pereira diz que atacar STF em campanha é “lamentável”
item.description: Marcos Pereira, president of the Republicans party, criticized the use of the Supreme Court (STF) as an electoral topic, calling it lamentable to discuss the impeachment of ministers during the campaign. He advocated for a review of the relationship between the Powers, noting a flagrant disharmony and excesses in the Judiciary, partly due to parties resorting to the Court after losing in Congress. Pereira said the Republicans are unlikely to support Lula’s re-election, indicating neutrality or support for Senator Flávio Bolsonaro, conditional on gestures in states where the party has pre-candidates, and warned that Bolsonaro must distance himself from radicalism to broaden his appeal.

item.title: Janja exibe Lula no Alvorada: “Merecido descanso”
item.description: First Lady Janja Lula da Silva posted on Instagram a photo of President Lula resting at the Palácio da Alvorada after a week of congressional setbacks and surgery to remove a basal cell carcinoma. The post, set to Gilberto Gil's song 'A Paz' and captioned 'Merecido descanso,' shows Lula in Bermuda shorts and flip-flops, reflecting his isolation for recovery. He is advised to wear a bandage and hat for about a month, per medical recommendation.

item.title: Flávio vai a SC para lançamento de filme sobre Bolsonaro em evento em que estenderá tapete a Carlos e De Toni
item.description: Senator Flávio Bolsonaro (PL-RJ), a pre-candidate for president, will attend the pre-launch of the film "A Colisão dos Destinos" in Santa Catarina on the 8th, where he will receive his brother Carlos Bolsonaro (PL) and deputy Caroline de Toni (PL), both pre-candidates for the Senate. Governor Jorginho Mello (PL) will also be present, while Senator Esperidião Amin (PP-SC), a family ally, was not invited.

item.title: Sintomas de uma doença
item.description: The text argues that the conflicts between Senate President Davi Alcolumbre and President Lula, along with the rejection of Jorge Messias for a Senate seat, are symptoms of a deeper institutional disease in Brazil. This disease lies in the distorted functioning of the Judiciary, particularly the STF, which has overstepped its constitutional role as guardian of the Constitution to act as a third legislative chamber, making decisions of opportunity and convenience that belong to elected powers. This imbalance undermines the separation of powers and distorts the 1988 constituent pact.

item.title: Atos de 1º de Maio pressionam pelo fim da escala 6 X 1
item.description: Trade unions held decentralized May Day protests across Brazil on May 1, 2026, focusing on ending the 6x1 work schedule, reducing working hours without wage cuts, and advancing labor rights such as combating violence against women, ending false self-employment (pejotização), and regulating app-based work. In São Paulo, the Avenida Paulista was reserved by conservative groups linked to the União Brasil Project, blocking traditional leftist union demonstrations and forcing relocation. The dispersion of protests reflects current political fragmentation and heightened tensions between the government and Congress following recent executive defeats.

item.title: Pacheco sinaliza a aliados que está fora das disputas para o STF e governo de Minas Gerais
item.description: Senator Rodrigo Pacheco (PSB-MG) signaled to allies that he does not intend to run for the Supreme Court or the governorship of Minas Gerais, following the rejection of Jorge Messias's STF nomination, which he supported while avoiding direct confrontation. Although previously considered by both Davi Alcolumbre and Lula for these roles, Pacheco is now distancing himself from the contests, aiming instead to act as a conciliator between the president and the Senate president in what may be his final political act.

item.title: O problema que trava a campanha de Lula e beneficia Flávio nas pesquisas, segundo especialistas
item.description: Despite positive macroeconomic indicators, Lula's government faces electoral malaise due to a disconnect between official achievements and citizens' daily experience of worsening living standards, driven by rising health costs, digital consumption, and other expenses squeezing household budgets. Experts say this communication and perception gap helps explain Flávio Bolsonaro's growth in polls, keeping the electoral race tight.

item.title: Crusoé: O informante Lula
item.description: Lula hosts special screenings of films about Brazil's military dictatorship at the Palácio da Alvorada, such as last year's showing of 'I'm Still Here' by Walter Salles, as a way to support democracy. This recurring practice reinforces his image as a defender of human rights and historical memory. The text suggests that by promoting these events, Lula seeks to strengthen the pro-democracy discourse in the current political landscape.

item.title: PT vai ao STF contra dosimetria aprovada no Congresso
item.description: The PT will appeal to the STF to annul Congress's override of Lula's veto on the Dosimetry Bill (PL 2162/2023), claiming the veto was improperly 'split' to bypass constitutional bicameral rules and the Anti-Fection Law. The party argues the law weakens democratic state protection and favors those who plotted institutional rupture. Led by deputies Pedro Uczai and Lindbergh Farias, the action awaits the law's promulgation.

item.title: Janones reclama do Primeiro de Maio “apagado” de Lula
item.description: Deputy André Janones (Avante-MG) criticized President Lula for failing to mobilize May Day demonstrations around the agenda to end the 6×1 workweek, which he calls a historic opportunity missed by the left. Janones argued that Lula let slip a chance to rally popular support for reducing working hours.

item.title: Messias cogita deixar o governo após rejeição em sabatina, e Lula pede que ele fique
item.description: Chief Minister of the AGU, Jorge Messias, admitted to allies that he is considering leaving the government after his nomination to the STF was rejected by the Senate. Still affected by the defeat, he expressed in messages his intention to leave the Esplanada. President Lula reportedly asked him to stay in the position.

item.title: Assessor de Janones é exonerado por invadir programa de TV ao vivo e xingar
item.description: Bernardo Moreira Amado Barros, an aide to André Janones, was fired by the Chamber of Deputies after invading a live Globonews broadcast, interrupting an interview, shouting insults and attempting to assault participants. He had claimed Lula would be re-elected in October and was handed over to Legislative Police. The opposition criticized the presence of such individuals in the Chamber and demanded further action.

item.title: Pesquisas eleitorais: o ‘ponto de virada’ para Flávio Bolsonaro na disputa contra Lula
item.description: The polarization between Lula and Flávio Bolsonaro has solidified as the central scenario of the 2026 election, with Flávio seen as the direct heir of Jair Bolsonaro’s political capital. Despite a technical tie in second-round simulations, the electorate remains highly volatile: 62% of voters do not know whom to support spontaneously, and 42% say they could change their vote, leaving the outcome undefined. High rejection of both candidates prevents a competitive third-way alternative.

item.title: Pré-candidato do PT ao governo do DF afirma que convidou PSB para unificar chapa, mas descarta ser vice
item.description: Leandro Grass, the PT's pre-candidate for governor of the Federal District, said he invited the PSB to form a unified ticket, offering the vice-governor spot, but ruled out running as vice himself. He emphasized that the PT's candidacy is irreversible and stressed the need for unity among Lula's supporters in Brasília to avoid past electoral losses due to division.

item.title: Lula anuncia pacote de R$ 21 bilhões para ampliar crédito à compra de caminhões
item.description: President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva announced a R$ 21.2 billion package to expand the Move Brasil program, which now includes financing for buses, minibuses, and road implements in addition to trucks. The funds consist of R$ 14.5 billion from the National Treasury and R$ 6.7 billion from BNDES, with a maximum of R$ 50 million per buyer and a focus on nationally manufactured vehicles. The program, which initially received R$ 10 billion and was exhausted in three months, has now more than doubled in size.

item.title: Crusoé: “Eu detestaria estar no lugar de quem me venceu”
item.description: Jorge Messias, the Attorney General of the Union in Lula's government, publicly criticized on X (formerly Twitter) those who blocked his nomination to the Supreme Federal Court (STF), citing anthropologist Darcy Ribeiro. He expressed resentment over the Senate's rejection of his nomination, stating he would 'hate to be in the place of those who defeated me'. The episode highlights political tensions surrounding judicial appointments in Lula's administration.

item.title: Indignado, Messias diz a aliados que derrota ao STF foi golpe de Moraes e Alcolumbre; ala do governo entra em modo ‘guerra’
item.description: Jorge Messias, Lula's nominee for the STF, was rejected by the Senate with 42 votes against and 34 in favor, which he denounced as a 'coup' orchestrated by Alexandre de Moraes, Flávio Dino, and Davi Alcolumbre. Government allies have entered 'war mode', framing the defeat as a direct political confrontation with the Supreme Court. Messias suggests the loss could bolster opposition narratives and is considering a move to lead the Justice Ministry to command the Federal Police.

item.title: Bolsonaro chega ao hospital para realizar cirurgia no ombro direito
item.description: Former President Jair Bolsonaro (PL) was admitted to DF Star Hospital in Brasília for right shoulder surgery, following authorization from STF Minister Alexandre de Moraes. The procedure, involving rotator cuff repair, began at 9 a.m. and is expected to last 3 hours, preceded by 2 hours of preparation. Bolsonaro is currently serving temporary house arrest for his conviction related to the attempted coup after the 2022 elections.

item.title: Alcolumbre usa com Lula táticas do Senado dos EUA para bater Reagan e Obama
item.description: Senator Davi Alcolumbre employed tactics inspired by the U.S. Senate’s approach to weakening presidents like Reagan and Obama, applying them against Brazilian President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva. By leveraging legislative obstruction and institutional checks, Alcolumbre aims to constrain Lula’s governing capacity. This reflects a recurring pattern of inter-branch conflict adapted across political systems.

item.title: R$ 2,3 bilhões: governo acelerou emendas após marcação de sabatina, mas nem liberação recorde evitou derrota de Messias
item.description: The federal government accelerated the release of R$ 2.3 billion in parliamentary amendments after scheduling Jorge Messias' STF confirmation hearing, but this did not prevent his defeat with 42 votes against and 34 in favor. Senator Davi Alcolumbre's behind-the-scenes efforts to secure opposition votes were decisive, and he accurately predicted the eight-vote margin. Since 1890, only six Supreme Court nominations have been rejected by the Senate — all in the 19th century except this one.

item.title: Rompimento entre Lula e Alcolumbre pode comprometer fim da escala 6×1
item.description: The growing rift between President Lula and Senator Davi Alcolumbre could jeopardize the approval of ending the 6×1 work scale in the Chamber of Deputies, as Alcolumbre is a key congressional articulator for the government. The rejection of Jorge Messias’ nomination to the STF has heightened tensions between the Executive and the Senate leader, potentially undermining negotiations on other priority agendas, such as labor reform. Although initially supported, the government now struggles to secure the necessary votes in the Special Committee and the full House.

item.title: Messias fora e pena reduzida para extremista: é o começo do fim da gestão Lula?
item.description: The rejection of Jorge Messias for the Supreme Court and the reduction of sentences for January 8 convicts mark significant setbacks for Lula, exposing political fragility and unlikely alliances between Bolsonarists, STF ministers, and congressional leaders. These events suggest a weakening of the government’s ability to build consensus, raising doubts about its sustainability ahead of the 2026 elections.

item.title: Lula detalha Desenrola 2.0 em pronunciamento; veja tudo o que se sabe sobre o programa
item.description: President Lula announced Desenrola 2.0, a new phase of the federal debt renegotiation program, set to launch on Monday, April 4. The program will allow renegotiation of credit card, overdraft, personal loan, and FIES debts, with interest capped at 1.99% per month and discounts ranging from 30% to 90%, plus the option to use up to 20% of FGTS balances to settle debts. It also includes a one-year CPF block on online betting platforms to prevent beneficiaries from re-accumulating debt through gambling.

item.title: Discurso conservador de Messias ‘descola’ da base e pode ter pesado em rejeição histórica
item.description: Jorge Rodrigo Araújo Messias’s STF nomination hearing featured a conservative discourse emphasizing religious identity and opposition to abortion, which alienated government allies and contributed to his historic Senate rejection — the first since 1894. Although he met technical qualifications, his strategy was perceived as a calculated outreach to the opposition, causing discomfort within the governing coalition and prompting Lula’s allies to reconsider nomination criteria.

item.title: Rejeição de Messias: petistas deconfiam até de Pacheco?
item.description: A faction of the PT close to Lula is expressing distrust toward former Senate President Rodrigo Pacheco (PSB) over the rejection of Jorge Messias’ nomination to the Supreme Court. According to Folha de S.Paulo, this group suspects Pacheco may have influenced the outcome after being passed over for the succession of Luís Roberto Barroso. The suspicion reveals internal PT tensions regarding congressional alliances and loyalty.

item.title: IstoÉ: meio século de profissionalismo e independência
item.description: IstoÉ magazine celebrates 50 years in 2026, reaffirming its role as a sentinel of democracy since its founding in 1976 during the military dictatorship. It gained prominence through investigations that led to the downfall of presidents, such as the 1992 revelation of PC Farias’ financial ties to Fernando Collor’s family, and by giving national visibility to figures like Lula in 1978. Its trajectory reflects a commitment to factual truth and independent journalism amid political, economic crises and today’s disinformation landscape.
